newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia sets tender for 51 pct of Sidanko Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: Russia sets tender for 51 pct of Sidanko Jan 10.

text.p: Russia will hold a commercial tender for 51 percent of oil firm NK Sidanko on January 10, according to the Federal Property Fund's Reforma bulletin.
The bulletin, of which an advance copy was distributed in electronic form before official publication on Tuesday, said 118.53 million shares would be offered.
However, a Sidanko spokesman said he was unaware of the tender.
Commercial bank MFK won the right to manage a 51 percent stake in Sidanko in last year's shares-for-loans scheme auctions.
A spokesman for the Uneximbank (Oneksimbank in Russian) banking group, of which MFK is a part, was also unaware of the tender.
In September, ZAO Interros Oil, affiliated with the Interros financial-industrial group built around Uneximbank, won an investment tender for 34 percent of Sidanko.
Sidanko's main operating units are Chernogorneft CHGZ.RTS 0#CHGZ.RUO, Kondpetroleum COND.RTS 0#COND.RUO and Varyoganneftegaz VJGZ.RTS 0#VJGZ.RUO. Its 1995 pre-tax profit was 2.12 trillion roubles.
